page.overview:
Who is Brit?

Guardians of the Globe Global Defense Agency

Brit Jr. (son) Euclid (half-brother) Britney (half-sister)

Lightblueincible † (victim) Angstrom Levy Powerplex

Brit is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 3 and onwards. He is a local superhero and an old friend of Cecil Stedman, working alongside the G.D.A. for clean-up jobs.
